title: Temporal Silt
text: Pale Temporal Silt covers the Time Continent. Living Temporal Silt keeps its base grain while adding faint curved lines.

Stilled Wastes preserve silt unchanged. In ordinary regions, fresh silt sediments in about five minutes, or half that time in Fleeting Woods; sedimented silt touching Decayed Timeflow can then rot. Recurrence Garden and Eventide Ruins suspend natural sedimentation: the garden cycles states at its nodes, while the ruins turn silt directly to rot.

Surround one Sedimented Living Temporal Silt with eight Light Crystal Cores in a crafting table. All ingredients are consumed to produce eight Solidified Light Crystal Cores. These no longer grow crystals and can be crafted or stonecut into stairs and slabs.
